Usage: csfmt [options] paths...

  --check               List files that would change without modifying them
  --concurrency <0..1>  Scale parallelism by CPU count (default: 1.0)

  paths...              C# source file, folder, or glob pattern (ex. "src/**/*.cs")
  --strict              Format with `dotnet format` command (folder only)
  --jb=before|after     Format with `JetBrains.ReSharper.GlobalTools` (folder only)

  --config              Show resolved config and file paths
  -h, --help            Show this help

Config (.editorconfig)

  root = true           Prevent directory traversal upwards
  charset = utf-8-bom   Add UTF-8 byte order mark
  end_of_line = crlf    NOT yet supported (always normalized to LF)
